astrometry.source: Courbin et al.2011, A&A536,A53, Table2 (This work), HST/NIC2 F160W simultaneous deconvolution
astrometry.coordinates: Published delta alpha and delta delta relative to imageA. A fixes origin; its zero coordinates have no independently quoted internal errors.
astrometry.systematic_note: Table2 explicitly requires additional2mas systematic errors. It does not publish a full positional covariance. Do not treat internal errors alone as total errors. Any covariance approximation must be stated.
astrometry.photometric_flux_ratios_not_used: Optical flux ratios are affected by intrinsic variability and microlensing; contemporaneous calibrated light curves provide the data instead.
astrometry.coordinate_use_note: Preserve published delta-alpha/delta-delta signs as the planar sky coordinates; positive right ascension is east and positive declination north. Origin imageA; subtractG coordinates only once to center a circular-body model. No position transformation or cosmological posterior is fitted here.

redshifts.source_updated_reference: Sluse et al.2012, Microlensing of the broad line region in17lensed quasars, A&A544,A62, DOI10.1051/0004-6361/201219125; value explicitly adopted in Bonvin et al.2017 (H0LiCOWV)
redshifts.note: H0LiCOWIV uses legacy1.689 and explicitly verifies updated1.693 does not affect their results. For new work declare choice rather than silently mix.
redshifts.choice: Use zl=.4546 and zs=1.693 in this new observed-lens application. Legacy1.689 retained only as a provenance note.
